messages:
Aisha: Quick PSA — the little garden gnome from the 3rd-floor demo desk is missing. Last seen Friday. Anyone borrow? :thinking:
Tom: Not me. Did it get promoted to 'official plant assistant'? :seedling:
Riley: I might've moved it to the kitchen for a "photo shoot". Oops. :grimace:
Aisha: @Riley please confess immediately or we start a missing-gnome hotline. :rotating_light:
Riley: Okay fine, I put it in the ramen shelf for scale. It's currently wearing a tiny post-it hat. It is safe. :sweat_smile:
Evan: Bring it back or I will replace it with a potato labeled 'gnome'.
Maya: Vote: keep the gnome, put it on a rotating desk residency schedule? React with :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no.
Tom: :thumbsup:
Aisha: :thumbsup:
Riley: :thumbsup: (guilty vote)
Evan: :thumbsdown: (I stand by my potato)
dev-bot: NOTE: Office inventory updated: 1 gnome — location: kitchen ramen shelf. Logged by Riley at 11:37AM.
Maya: Awesome. Gratitude to Riley for dramatic photo op — please leave it on my desk after lunch. :camera_with_flash:
Riley: Will do. Also will include tiny post-it hat as part of the "welcome back" ceremony.
Aisha: This thread saved a gnome's life. Closing case. :detective:
Tom: Filing for 'Gnome of the Month' award.
Evan: Potato is still on standby.
